name: Molten Palm
description: Press a palm glowing with magma heat into the target so the qi burns slowly through guard and skin.

name: Lava Jab
description: Jab a fist coated in thick hot qi that clings to the foe for a breath after the hit.

name: Slag Guard
description: Smear a thick coat of half-cooled slag qi over the forearms to take blows on its crust.

name: Searing Grip
description: Close a hot hand on a limb and hold it until the glow makes the foe pull back and stay stuck.

name: Slag Flick
description: Flick a small glowing clot of magma qi from the fingers at the face of a foe.

name: Scoria Step
description: Step onto a crust of scoria qi that bears the weight for one pace and cools at once.

name: Lava Press
description: Lean the whole body behind a slow palm that presses hot qi deep into the chest of the target.

name: Oozing Fist
description: Drive a fist that leaves a sticky smear of hot qi which keeps burning on the skin.

name: Creeping Burn
description: Hold a palm on the target and let the heat spread outward through the flesh a little each breath.

name: Basalt Block
description: Set a forearm hardened like dark stone against a blow and turn it off along the arm.

name: Molten Drip
description: Let a heavy drop of liquid qi fall from the fingertips and splash hot across the foe's feet.

name: Molten Pace
description: Plant each foot with the slow weight of flowing stone so a shove cannot move the body.

name: Sludge Shove
description: Push through a foe's stance with thick hot qi that drags at their feet and slows the next move.

name: Glow Sense
description: Open the senses to the warmth held in stone and learn where a body or a wall is hottest.

name: Sinew Warmth
description: Read the heat in a foe's limbs to learn which side holds the most qi ready to strike.

name: Crust Probe
description: Press a hand to the ground or a wall and feel how thick and how firm its hardened skin is.

name: Flow Gauge
description: Judge how fast the hot qi runs inside a body to tell how soon it will gather for a strike.

name: Pumice Screen
description: Raise a light porous screen of cooled qi that soaks the first force of a blow.

name: Crust Guard
description: Chill the skin of the arms into a hard dark crust that stops a strike while the heat stays within.

name: Obsidian Skin
description: Hold a glassy edged layer of cooled qi over the torso that cuts at hands that strike it.

name: Cooling Block
description: Cool the forearm to stone in the instant of contact and shove the blow wide.

name: Shard Snap
description: Break the cooled crust off the knuckles in sharp pieces as the fist lands.

name: Basalt Stance
description: Stand with the body set like a column of dark stone and take blows on a hardened surface.

name: Fissure Tap
description: Tap the foe's guard at a seam of weakness and let the heat split it open.

name: Magma Step
description: Glide forward on a heavy slow step that leaves a faint glow where the foot passed.

name: Flowing Stride
description: Pour the body along a curved path with no pause between paces like a slow tongue of lava.

name: Melt Slide
description: Slide a foot forward as if the ground had softened and bring the body in under the guard.

name: Lava Kick
description: Swing a low kick in which the shin burns hot and leaves a bright scorch on the target.

name: Glowing Heel
description: Stamp down a heel that glows with magma qi and pins the foe's foot with the heat.

name: Scorch Pivot
description: Turn on the ball of the foot and leave a hot print that the foe hesitates to cross.

name: Slag Sweep
description: Sweep a low leg trailing thick hot qi to drag the foe's feet out from under them.

name: Sear Lunge
description: Lunge in a long glide with a burning palm held out and brand the foe's chest.

name: Melting Touch
description: Lay a hot hand on the foe's wrist so the grip slumps and loses its force.

name: Slump Palm
description: Strike a shoulder with a palm that softens the muscle under it until the arm sags.

name: Magma Brand
description: Press the palm flat on the target and leave a glowing mark that keeps burning.

name: Pooling Heat
description: Let heat pool in the ground at the user's feet and spill out to scorch all who stand near.

name: Searing Seep
description: Let a thin bright thread of hot qi seep from the hand and run along the ground to the foe.

name: Heated Ward
description: Hold a shimmer of heat around the body that scorches any hand reaching in.
